help.chat.title: Chat
help.chat.summary: The family room, private messages, and group threads you create yourself.
help.chat.rooms.heading: The three kinds of room
help.chat.rooms.b0.i0.text: One room, everybody in it, created for you. It cannot be left or deleted.
help.chat.rooms.b0.i1.text: A private thread between you and one other member.
help.chat.rooms.b0.i2.text: A named thread with the people you choose — a planning committee, the cousins organising a gift.
help.chat.rooms.b1: Messages arrive live. A dot beside a room means there is something in it you have not read; opening the room clears it.
help.chat.dm.heading: Starting a private message
help.chat.dm.b0.i0: Press **New DM** at the top of the room list.
help.chat.dm.b0.i2: Type and send. Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line.
help.chat.dm.b1: Only members with an account appear in the list. Somebody recorded on the family tree with no email address has nothing to receive a message at — see [Records and accounts](/help/family-tree#records).
help.chat.group.heading: Starting a group
help.chat.group.b0.i1: Name it — the name is what everybody else will see in their list.
help.chat.group.b0.i2: Tick the people to include, and press **Create Group**.
help.chat.group.b1: Whoever creates a group can add and remove members afterwards, from the control at the top right of the thread.
help.chat.deleting.heading: Removing a conversation
help.chat.deleting.b0: A direct message thread can be deleted from your list. The family room cannot — it is the one place the whole family can always be reached.
